name: rail-view
summary: Graph mode becomes a rail beside full cards
body: The canvas DAG could not survive a 220-480px pane: fixed-width nodes truncated titles and the drawing either shrank into illegibility or clipped. Graph mode now keeps the list's full-width, fixed-height cards (native buttons — keyboard accessible for free) and draws the dependency evidence as bracket edges in a left rail, the shape every commit graph uses. Lineage highlighting, edge-weight strokes, and evidence tooltips carry over unchanged.
